definitions.gloss: height of prosperity; heyday; peak; zenith
definitions.explanation: The period when something or someone is at the peak of power, popularity, or success.

examples.japanese: {全盛期|ぜんせいき}は{過|す}ぎた。
あの{歌手|かしゅ}は{今|いま}が{全盛期|ぜんせいき}だ。
examples.english: That singer is at the peak of their career right now.

examples.japanese: スマートフォン{全盛|ぜんせい}の{時代|じだい}に、あえてガラケーを{使|つか}う{人|ひと}もいる。
examples.english: Even in the age of smartphone dominance, some people deliberately use flip phones.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {全|ぜん} (complete, all) + {盛|せい} (prosperity, flourishing). Most commonly appears in the compound {全盛期|ぜんせいき} (heyday, golden age). Also used attributively as ～{全盛|ぜんせい}の{時代|じだい} (the era of ～'s dominance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全盛期|ぜんせいき} (heyday, golden age)
- {全盛|ぜんせい}を{極|きわ}める (to reach the height of prosperity)
- ～{全盛|ぜんせい}の{時代|じだい} (the era when ～ was dominant)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最盛期|さいせいき}: peak period — very similar, emphasizes the absolute peak
- {絶頂|ぜっちょう}: peak, climax — the highest point, often used for emotions or power
